part: ACT FOUR · THE BLIP, told twice · draft 5.1
variant: stick-figure dialogue reel v5 · the recorded takes over a temp bed
logline: Act Four for flow and dialogue: the v5 takes laid to the v5 shot plan, one beat per shot. Stick figures and text cards stand in for the picture.

beats.caption: The suite over the Strip. A crane truck grinds past; every glass shivers except his.
cues: music: temp MM-07 BLUEPRINT waltz (mm07 underscore) · thins + ducks ~-10 dB under talk · tape-stop on JOIN

beats.caption: He nudges the glass true. On the laptop: BOARD · VIDEO CALL · JOIN. The glow turns to blueprint.
Her blueprint figure reads the board's plan. Three chairs walk off; a ring draws round the four.

lines.text: Three of us stepped down this year.
Leave out Mas and Gerg, and the four of us are a majority.
This board controls the company. Not the other way round.

onscreen.text: ALYI · NELEH · MADA · THE QUIET VOTE

seq.place: THE PLAN: the blueprint behind the button

beats.caption: The investor's key ring gets VOTES: 0; the CEO box gets EQUITY: 0. The two zeros hold side by side.

lines.text: Our biggest investor has put in billions. It gets this many votes.
And the CEO? What does he own?

beats.frame: GFX · the path and the break
beats.caption: The four step onto a numbered path; step 1 is NOON · VIDEO CALL. The fold curls; the sheet tears.
He clicks JOIN; the waltz tape-stops to zero on the click.
His side: no words reach us. Alyi's tile takes the speaking ring; a dialog pops over Mas's tile.

seq.place: the board call, on his laptop

cues: music: temp MM-08 LEVERAGE low (mm08 underscore) · hard stop on the Cancel click

beats.caption: His pupils move one pixel toward the dialog. Nothing else moves.
An arrow tagged ALYI / CO-FOUNDER steps onto Cancel and clicks. Silence. His tile falls out.

onscreen.text: You've been removed from the meeting.

cues: sound: the one deliberate silence (Cancel click -> phone buzz): music and room out, room tone only

beats.caption: Mas, full frame, the one-pixel smile. Nothing changes.
The phone buzzes and the room comes back. Suggested replies; his thumb takes the middle one.
cues: sound: the suite comes back on the buzz · no score under "super."

beats.frame: OTS · over Mas onto the laptop
beats.caption: "super." into the laptop. The four tiles freeze on the word. The room falls away to night.
With the pen he pocketed from the MACROSOFT check, he carves a third mark beside two faint ones.
cues: music: temp MM-08 26A felt (mm08 underscore) · thins under the V.O.

beats.frame: INSERT · the three marks, from above
beats.caption: The Orb's eye-light steps onto mark 1. The Orb is counting.
A render front out of mark 1: a frosted boardroom door, two shadows leaning together.

onscreen.text: RAIL: TPOOL, HIS FIRST COMPANY · TWO STAFF REVOLTS · (REPORTED)

beats.caption: The light steps to mark 2, then 3, and stops on his thumb.
The iris lifts to his face. Toast: rewinding… A whip right to left into pass one.

beats.frame: OTS · over Neleh onto her laptop (held, slow push)
beats.caption: Their side: the fifth tile connects, perfectly still. Alyi tells him in plain words.

lines.text: Mas. The board has decided that you will no longer lead the company. It will be announced shortly.

onscreen.text: Waiting for MAS MANALT to join…

cues: music: temp PROCEDURE (MM-09 underscore), one performance for pass one · thins + ducks under talk

beats.caption: His tile simply goes; a lit audio chip stays. Tinny, out of it: "super." Nobody looks up.

onscreen.text: MAS MANALT was removed from the meeting.

beats.caption: Her pen ticks step 1 and runs down what the fold hid; it stops on the blank step 4.

lines.text: Step two. I'll read it once before it goes up.

beats.frame: SCREEN · the blog, in its own UI
beats.caption: "Step two." She reads the post once before it goes up, asks for objections, gets none, posts.

lines.text: …he was not consistently candid in his communications with the board… The board no longer has confidence in his ability to continue leading NopeAI.

onscreen.text: …he was not consistently candid in his communications with the board…
The board no longer has confidence in his ability to continue leading NopeAI.

beats.frame: OTS · over Neleh onto the grid (held)
beats.caption: A join chime; a spotlight finds Rima's tile. Step three: she is interim CEO, and told nothing more.

lines.text: Step three. Rima, thank you for agreeing to serve as interim CEO while we search.
The staff will ask you what happened.
What the post says. That's all the board is saying for now.

beats.frame: SINGLE · MCU Neleh, one brow up
beats.caption: "Will we?" Rima's "More. Soon." plays on Neleh's face. Pen tick: step 3.

beats.frame: WIDE · the all-hands, from the back
beats.caption: A match cut to the real doorway. One employee is already standing, hand up. The crowd hushes.

lines.text: Is this a coup? Because it looks like one.

beats.frame: SINGLE · MCU Alyi in the doorway (held)
beats.caption: Alyi answers in the record's words, with a real pause to look at her. Then he steps back out.

lines.text: You can call it this way… I disagree with this. This was the board doing its duty to the mission of the nonprofit…

beats.caption: Her lamp is on. Gerg's post lands as the call's own notification; keycaps rain across the grid.

lines.text: Nobody asked him to go. He'd have kept his job, just not the chair.
Gerg has never waited to be asked.

beats.caption: Hearts pour over the call until the tiles are buried; his post scrolls across. One blue heart.

onscreen.text: POST: MAS: “…sorta like reading your own eulogy while you're still alive”

beats.caption: Four phones buzz and step toward the edge. Neleh, with a marker, talks to the room in full.

lines.text: They're all asking whether it was allowed. It was. The charter, footnote three. I've read it four times tonight.
What they actually want to know is what happens on Monday. I'd like to be able to tell them something.

beats.frame: OTS · over Neleh onto the window (Alyi's reflection)
beats.caption: Alyi, a reflection in the dark window, not turning: step four will reveal itself.

beats.frame: TWO-SHOT · Neleh and Mada, Alyi's reflection between
beats.caption: "That isn't a time." The first phone goes off the edge: clack. She looks down at it.

lines.text: That isn't a time, Alyi. All we've given the staff since yesterday is more soon.
That is the company telling us.

beats.caption: She looks at the blank line, decides, pulls the speakerphone over and dials: four tones.

lines.text: Then we'll write step four ourselves.

beats.frame: SPLIT · both calls, one held shot
beats.caption: Neleh offers Mario the job. He has eleven pages; Adelina takes the phone: no. Then Nozama calls.

lines.text: Mario, it's Neleh, from the NopeAI board. I'll be direct. The board is offering you the job of CEO, and it wants to discuss a merger.
Neleh, hi. Wow. I've actually written up some thoughts on exactly this. Eleven pages, on the conditions under which we might, hypothetically—
Hi. Yes. We're very worried. How much?

onscreen.text: NOZAMA · UP TO $4B  ·  ELGOOG · UP TO $2B

seq.place: split: the boardroom / the rival lab's lighthouse

beats.frame: OTS · over Neleh onto the lobby camera
beats.caption: On the CCTV: a familiar figure at reception in a GUEST lanyard. On "here" he walks out.

lines.text: He's been in the building for hours. We've talked all day about him coming back, and we're no closer.
They gave him a guest badge.
It's the correct badge. He doesn't work here.

onscreen.text: POST: MAS: “first and last time i ever wear one of these”

seq.place: the boardroom (the lobby camera on its wall screen)

beats.caption: Rima's spotlight swings off her tile onto a new arrival in the CEO chair: hoodie, headset, hourglass.

beats.frame: TWO-SHOT · Neleh and Ttemme across the table (held)
beats.caption: "We'd like a different one." He wants to know why. A sealed folder; he reads it turned away.

lines.text: Ttemme, we'd like you to serve as interim CEO.
You already have an interim CEO.
Fine. But before I say yes, I need to know why you fired him.

beats.caption: He flips the hourglass; the sand starts. To his chat: "Chat… for how long?"

onscreen.text: LIVE · CHAT:  F  F  F  F

beats.caption: The wall steps to MACROSOFT slate blue. A door that was not there appears in it, and opens.

beats.frame: SINGLE · MCU Tasya in the new doorway
beats.caption: Tasya, delighted, phone in hand: "You'll want to hear our statement." He reads it whole.

lines.text: Good evening. You'll want to hear our statement.

We look forward to getting to know Ttemme and NopeAI's new leadership team and working with them. And we're extremely excited to share the news that Mas Manalt and Gerg Mockbran, together with colleagues, will be joining Macrosoft to lead a new advanced AI research team.

onscreen.text: TASYA · THE LANDLORD · MACROSOFT · NOPEAI RUNS ON ITS SERVERS

beats.frame: MEDIUM · Ttemme in the CEO chair, Tasya beyond
beats.caption: The first sentence lands on the man it welcomes. Ttemme nods back, pleased and slightly lost.
The second sentence lands on the board: Mas and Gerg are joining Macrosoft. Her pen stops.

beats.frame: SINGLE · MCU Tasya lifts the sign
beats.caption: A small cartoon sign, arrow pointing out. The key ring jangles once.
Her marker comes into frame. "Step four?" She writes one mark on it: ?
Mada, arms folded, spinner turning. He doesn't answer. Pass one ends.
The door back. Black, cream type.

beats.frame: INSERT · the home shot: glass and lanyard
beats.caption: The glass, its water line one flat row, and the GUEST lanyard laid square beside it.

seq.place: his dark room (Gerg on the monitor)

cues: music: temp DARK ROOM pedal + pulse (v4 S5 render, looped) · ducks under talk

beats.caption: Rima's post, then the same words from everyone. He hearts every one on the beat.

onscreen.text: RIMA: “NopeAI is nothing without its people”

beats.caption: The Orb's iris steps off the phone onto the lanyard. He answers the look.
The Orb does not look away. The one true word. Rack to the Orb.

beats.frame: OTS · over Mas onto the monitor, Gerg's tile big
beats.caption: The staff letter is already open. Gerg's tile rings; Mas clicks it. Gerg is typing, 2 AM.

lines.text: Sorry, one sec. I've got a build compiling.
it's two in the morning, gerg.
Best time there is. Nobody else is pushing anything. Anyway, that's not why I called. You've got the staff letter open? Scroll down.

beats.frame: POV · his monitor: the letter, one page, a slow scroll
beats.caption: Gerg reads the letter as each line scrolls up; the count rolls to 745. The scroll stops on ALYI.

lines.text: They're telling the board they're "…unable to work for or with people that lack competence, judgment and care for our mission and employees."
And they'll quit, "…unless all current board members resign…"
Yep. Macrosoft's promised them "…positions for all NopeAI employees…"

onscreen.text: “…unable to work for or with people that lack competence, judgment and care for our mission and employees.”

beats.frame: SINGLE · MCU Mas, the monitor's light
beats.caption: "alyi voted." / "He did both." Hold on Mas a beat: the pause is his.
A check slides out of the rack's slot. Gerg explains it; then the stamp: VOID IF CEO MISSING.

lines.text: That'll be the share sale. Everybody's been waiting on that one.

beats.frame: OTS · back over Mas onto the monitor
beats.caption: "what are you building?" Gerg, still typing, sunny. His keys stop after "case".

lines.text: The company. Again. Just in case.

beats.frame: POV · cut-in: Gerg's tile fills the monitor
beats.caption: His one look up, at Mas. The Build and his keys stop; the pedal holds. Then he types again.

lines.text: So. Do I tell everyone to pack?

beats.frame: TWO-SHOT · the back wall; the slate door rises
beats.caption: A slate-blue door steps up out of the shadow, Tasya's sign taped to it. A key turns. His voice.

lines.text: Don't get up, Mas. I won't keep you. Everyone is welcome.
Yes. You first. And there's a desk for every one of them.

beats.frame: SINGLE · MCU Mas, the door soft behind
beats.caption: After a full offer, and a pause that belongs to the door. Rack to the door, open a crack.
The grid he watched from their side. One employee tile lands; then ten; then hundreds.
cues: music: temp SET-PIECE SWING (v4 S6 render) · dead stop on MADA's label

beats.caption: Mas watching, blank. Each landing steps the room's light.
Alyi's tile grows, resists one beat, and is shoved off the edge.
Neleh's tile follows, footnotes scattering. The avalanche takes the end of her question.
The black tile goes without a sound. Mada, wedged in, does not move. His label flips; dead stop.

onscreen.text: THE QUIET VOTE left the call

beats.frame: BOX · the two boxes (the act's one box, held)
beats.caption: Alyi's regret pops up in his box; three hearts rise from Mas's and hang. They talk about the hearts.

onscreen.text: POST: ALYI: “I deeply regret my participation in the board's actions. I never intended to harm NopeAI…”

cues: music: temp MM-11 THE RETURN (v4 S7/S8 render) · thins + ducks under talk

beats.caption: Every desk has a packed box; everyone has a coat on. Tasya stands in the middle of the floor.

lines.text: what happens to you if nopeai disappears?

beats.caption: "Oh, we'd be fine." Then the record: below, above, around. The floor, ceiling and walls turn slate.

lines.text: Oh, we'd be fine. …we have all the IP rights and all the capability… We are below them, above them, around them.

beats.caption: Mas looks straight down at the slate floor. From under him, warmly: "Hello."
Mada, perfectly still, in the only chair not burning. Nobody has mentioned the fires.
The door bangs; Terb, extinguisher like a briefcase. Freeze. Mas pulls the pin and pockets it.
"Which room is on fire?" Everyone looks around. "…Ah."

beats.frame: TWO-SHOT · the calm-off, Terb in depth (held)
beats.caption: Terb reads the announcement once before it goes out, "(Chair)" about himself.

lines.text: Before this goes out, I'm reading it once, so nobody's surprised. We have reached an agreement in principle for Mas Manalt to return to NopeAI as CEO with a new initial board of Terb (Chair), the Other Yrral, and Mada.

beats.caption: On his name: a seated silhouette behind a nameplate. He nods once.
"you're staying?" Terb answers for Mada. The review. "of what?" The music drops out. Mada.

lines.text: He stays. You and Gerg don't sit on the board.
And there'll be an independent review.

cues: music: dead stop after "of what?" · the room holds Mada's pause

beats.caption: One beat late, dry, needling the dodge back at him.

beats.frame: TWO-SHOT · the calm-off, the long hold
beats.caption: The long hold. Mada's spinner stops; he nods. Terb stamps the sheet. Mas's phone lights: Gerg.

onscreen.text: POST: GERG: “Returning to NopeAI & getting back to coding tonight.”

beats.frame: OVERHEAD · the hourglass, his chat panel
beats.caption: The last grain runs out. Ttemme's post holds and clears; then, to his chat. The glass shatters.

onscreen.text: POST: TTEMME: “I am deeply pleased by this result, after ~72 very intense hours of work.”

beats.caption: The sign lights on a brass stab. Mas at reception, no badge. A box of spare 0 plates.

onscreen.text: DAYS SINCE SOMEONE TRIED TO FIRE MAS: 0

beats.frame: OTS · over Mas onto the last dialog
beats.caption: The dialog once more; Cancel greys. An arrow with an empty tag clicks it. Bonk: refused.
The firing's drawing again, with the lobby's tungsten behind him.

beats.frame: INSERT · the glass on the stone
beats.caption: He sets the glass down and nudges it one pixel true. Over the hands: "okay."
A squat steel vault stencilled Q*. It hums at the score's root, F.
cues: music: MM-11 felt settle into the vault's F hum (temp) · the hum alone under the memo

beats.frame: TWO-SHOT · Mas and Gerg, the vault between
beats.caption: "Is it ready?" "it's a preview." Rack to the vault; Gerg walks out. Then the rail.

lines.text: You said that about the last one.

onscreen.text: DO NOT OPEN. DO NOT EXPLAIN.
RAIL: (REPORTED) RESEARCHERS WROTE OF A BREAKTHROUGH CALLED Q*

beats.frame: WIDE · the bullpen, the memo (slow drift)
beats.caption: Coats off, boxes being unpacked. He reads his memo to the staff who stayed.

lines.text: i love and respect alyi, i think he's a guiding light of the field and a gem of a human being. i harbor zero ill will towards him.

beats.caption: The second sentence lands on a prop: four screws, and the ALYI plate comes off the scorched chair.
The conference-room door, shut, its nameplate still on.

beats.frame: WIDE · the observer chair (the act's last image)
beats.caption: A MACROSOFT-blue folding chair unfolds itself by the window. It stays empty. A key ring drops.
